name: column-group-table
title: Column group table
description: A table with grouped column headers: spanning headers over sub-columns, built with proper scope so screen readers still hear them.
docs: Give it columnGroups (an id, a label and columns), rows and an optional rowHeader. Give a group a summary column key and it can be folded down to that column. Pass label to name the scroll box and a caption to say what the figures are. Columns read row[key]; use accessor and cell for anything else. With a rowHeader, the label of a group and its button stay beside the row names while the group's columns scroll under them.
